You don’t need to build every component of an ML trading research system from scratch.

These three open-source projects give you different ways to explore machine learning in algorithmic trading:

🔶 Qlib — Research predictive signals, train ML models, and test quantitative strategies.

🔵 FinRL — Experiment with reinforcement learning agents that learn trading decisions in simulated market environments.

🟣 TensorTrade — Build custom trading environments, define reward functions, and experiment with your own RL strategies.

The workflow is what matters:

→ Collect and clean historical market data
→ Engineer useful features
→ Train models or reinforcement learning agents
→ Convert predictions into explicit trading rules
